name: k7-tray
description: The menu-bar view over engine/k7-supervisor, on Electron: spawns it, draws its snapshots in the tray and one settings window, sends clicks back, and keeps itself current from k7.rocks/app_downloads. See docs/tray.md.
author: F <fred@parapluie.org>

scripts.package: node scripts/build-main.mjs && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --publish never
